name: datestr_codes
expr: s0 = datestr(dn,0); n0 = numel(s0); c0 = sum(double(s0)); s4 = datestr(dn,4); n4 = numel(s4); c4 = double(s4(1)); s9 = datestr(dn,9); c9 = double(s9(1)); s14 = datestr(dn,14); n14 = numel(s14); c14 = sum(double(s14)); s17 = datestr(dn,17); n17 = numel(s17); c17 = sum(double(s17)); s18 = datestr(dn,18); n18 = numel(s18); c18 = sum(double(s18)); s23 = datestr(dn,23); n23 = numel(s23); c23 = sum(double(s23)); s27 = datestr(dn,27); c27 = sum(double(s27)); s30 = datestr(dn,30); n30 = numel(s30); c30 = sum(double(s30)); s31 = datestr(dn,31); n31 = numel(s31); c31 = sum(double(s31));
comment: datestr numeric format codes 0-31 (covers datestr; separate from datestr.json to stay under the VM 255-register limit). DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31: codes previously threw 'numeric format codes not yet supported'. Mapped to MATLAB's dateform table + added the m (single month letter), d (single weekday letter), QQ (quarter) tokens to the format parser. dn=datenum(2020,7,28,14,24,5): code 0='28-Jul-2020 14:24:05', 4='J', 9='T', 14=' 2:24:05 PM', 17='Q3-20', 18='Q3', 23='07/28/2020', 27='Q3-2020', 30='20200728T142405', 31='2020-07-28 14:24:05'. All 32 verified bit-identical vs MATLAB R2025b. Cross-engine fingerprint via numel + sum(char codes).
